title: Mediterranean Yellow Pilaf with Spicy Kick
description: A flavorful and spicy pilaf dish with yellow pilaf, mediterranean spices, and a kick from doubanjiang. Serve as a hearty side dish or light meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the mediterranean spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the yellow pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the doubanjiang and cook for another minute, until combined.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley or lemon wedges if desired.
